I'll diagnose and fix the Kubernetes pod issue. Let me start by gathering information about the pod.Now I can see the problem clearly. The pod is using an image with typos: "misspeling-app:latset" which should likely be "misspelling-app:latest". The image pull policy is "Never" and the image isn't present locally. Let me check the deployment to fix this at the source:Perfect! I can see the deployment has the misspelled image name "misspeling-app:latset" instead of "misspelling-app:latest". I need to fix the deployment, which will automatically recreate the pods with the correct image. Let me patch the deployment:Perfect! The deployment has been updated with the correct image name. This will trigger a rolling update that will recreate all the pods with the correct image.

## DIAGNOSIS:
The pod was failing with "ErrImageNeverPull" error because the container image was misspelled as "misspeling-app:latset" instead of "misspelling-app:latest".

## FIX APPLIED:
I ran `kubectl set image deployment/misspelling-deployment myapp=misspelling-app:latest -n case6-test` to correct the image name in the deployment. This will trigger Kubernetes to perform a rolling update, terminating the old pods and creating new ones with the correct image name.
